ko.title: 교착 상태인가, 아니면 마감 시한에 의한 통치인가? 분열된 의회가 지출, 감독, 부채에 미칠 의미

segments.src: When voters go to the polls in November, one question sits underneath many others: who will control which chamber of Congress?
segments.tr: 11월 유권자들이 투표소로 향할 때, 많은 질문들 아래에는 한 가지 질문이 자리 잡고 있습니다. 누가 의회의 어느 원을 장악할 것인가 하는 점입니다.

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: 하원, 상원, 또는 둘 다 백악관과 다른 당의 손에 넘어가게 된다면, 워싱턴의 향후 2년은 매우 다르게 보일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: History suggests that divided government rarely means "nothing happens."
segments.tr: 역사는 분열된 정부가 곧 "아무것도 일어나지 않는다"는 것을 의미하지는 않는다는 점을 시사합니다.

segments.src: It usually means that *different* things happen, and that most of them happen at the last minute.
segments.tr: 이는 보통 *다른* 일들이 일어나며, 그 대부분이 마지막 순간에 일어난다는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: 이 설명 자료는 과거의 경험을 바탕으로 분열된 의회가 지출, 감독, 지명, 국가 부채를 어떻게 변화시키는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: 이 자료는 선거 결과를 예측하거나 특정 정당을 지지하지 않습니다.

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: 아래의 패턴들은 공화당과 민주당이 다수당이었던 시절 모두에서 나타났습니다.

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## 분열된 정부가 실제로 변화시키는 것

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: 헌법에 따라 법안은 양원 모두에서 동일한 형태로 통과되어야 하며, 이후 대통령의 서명을 받아야 합니다.

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: 거부권은 각 원에서 3분의 2 이상의 찬성이 있어야만 무효화될 수 있는데, 이는 좀처럼 도달하기 어려운 기준입니다.

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: 한 정당이 백악관을 장악하고 다른 정당이 의회의 한 원을 장악하면, 각 진영은 상대방의 우선순위에 대해 거부권을 행사하게 됩니다.

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: 이는 몇 가지 예측 가능한 결과를 낳습니다:

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **새로운 대규모 입법은 더 어려워집니다.** 세금, 의료, 기후에 관한 포괄적인 법안은 보통 통합된 통제권이나, 드물게는 초당적 연합이 필요합니다.

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **반드시 통과시켜야 하는 법안이 협상 수단이 됩니다.** 정부 자금 지원, 국방 정책, 부채 한도 변경과 같이 의회가 쉽게 건너뛸 수 없는 조치들이 협상의 주요 수단이 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **감독이 강화됩니다.** 대통령직을 차지하지 못한 정당은 행정부를 면밀히 조사할 수 있는 도구를 얻게 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **인사 갈등이 커집니다.** 상원과 백악관이 서로 다른 정당에 의해 통제된다면, 인준 과정은 더 느려지고 더 많은 논쟁을 겪을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## 지출: 왜 마감 시한이 지배하는가

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: 의회는 10월 1일 회계연도가 시작되기 전에 12개의 연례 세출 법안을 통과시켜야 합니다.

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: 1997 회계연도 이후로 이 작업을 제시간에 완료한 적이 없습니다.

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: 최근 거의 매년, 의원들은 협상이 계속되는 동안 기관을 계속 운영하기 위해 임시 "지속 결의안"에 의존해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: 분열된 정부는 이러한 패턴을 더욱 심화시키는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽도 자신의 예산을 강요할 수 없기 때문에, 협상은 실패의 대가가 가시화되는 마감 시한을 향해 밀려납니다.

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: 여러 사례가 다양한 결과를 보여줍니다:

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011년:** 2010년 중간선거 결과 분열된 의회가 구성된 후, 부채 한도 대치 상황은 예산통제법으로 끝났으며, 이는 지출 상한선과 시퀘스터(sequester)라고 알려진 자동적인 전면 삭감을 설정했습니다. 신용평가사 스탠더드 앤드 푸어스(S&P)는 그해 여름, 부분적으로 정치적 벼랑 끝 전술을 이유로 미국의 신용등급을 강등했습니다.

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013년:** 공화당 하원과 민주당 상원 및 대통령 체제에서 10월에 16일간의 부분적인 정부 폐쇄가 발생했습니다.

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018~2019년:** 당시 최장 기간인 35일간의 부분 폐쇄가 공화당의 통합 통제 하에 시작되어 2019년 1월 민주당이 하원을 장악한 후에도 계속되었습니다. 그해 말 초당적 예산 합의를 통해 부채 한도가 유예되고 2년간의 지출 수준이 설정되었습니다.

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023년:** 공화당 하원과 민주당 상원 및 대통령 체제에서 재정책임법이 부채 한도를 유예하고 일부 지출 상한선을 설정하여 잠재적인 채무 불이행을 피했습니다.

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: 교훈은 분열된 정부가 항상 정부 폐쇄를 초래한다는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: 여러 경우에 분열된 정부는 통합된 정부가 하지 못한 다년도 예산 합의를 이끌어냈습니다.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: 하지만 그러한 합의에 이르는 길은 종종 벼랑 끝 전술을 먼저 거쳐야 했습니다.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## 감독: 청문회, 소환장 및 조사

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: 각 원의 다수당은 위원회 위원장을 선출하고 의제를 설정합니다.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: 위원회는 청문회를 열고, 문서를 요청하며, 소환장을 발부할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: 야당이 원을 장악하면, 일반적으로 같은 당이 다수당일 때보다 행정부를 상대로 이러한 도구를 더 공격적으로 사용합니다.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: 하원은 탄핵 소추권을, 상원은 탄핵 심판권을 가집니다.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: 이는 드물고 심각한 조치이지만, 통제권이 분열될 때마다 그 가능성이 정치적 분위기를 변화시킵니다.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: 조사는 정책 변화, 사임, 또는 새로운 입법과 같은 실질적인 효과를 가져올 수 있습니다.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: 또한 조사는 입법에 쓰일 수 있는 시간과 관심을 소모할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이를 행정 권력에 대한 필수적인 견제 수단으로 보지만, 비판자들은 종종 이를 정치적 쇼로 간주합니다.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: 어떤 견해가 적용되는지는 종종 어느 정당이 조사를 받고 있는지에 따라 달라지며, 이는 양당 모두 야당 시절에 같은 도구를 사용해 왔다는 점을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## 인준 및 법원

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: 상원은 내각 관료, 대사, 연방 판사를 인준합니다.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: 2013년과 2017년의 규칙 변경 이후, 대법관 지명자를 포함한 대부분의 지명은 60표가 아닌 단순 과반수로 통과될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: 이는 상원을 장악한 정당이 누가 인준될지에 대해 상당한 권한을 가진다는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: 상원과 백악관이 서로 다른 당의 손에 있다면, 더 긴 대기 시간, 더 많은 지명 철회, 그리고 직무 대행자에 대한 더 큰 의존을 예상해야 합니다.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: 만약 그들이 같은 당이라면, 하원이 야당일지라도 인준은 더 빠르게 진행되는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: 이로 인해 상원 선거 결과는 사법부 및 행정부 임명에 특히 중요합니다.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## 부채: 마감 시한이 시장과 만나는 곳

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: 연방 부채는 37조 달러를 넘어섰으며, 연간 적자는 경제가 좋을 때나 나쁠 때나 모두 컸습니다.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: 법정 부채 한도는 새로운 지출을 승인하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: 이는 의회가 이미 승인한 의무를 이행하기 위해 필요한 차입 한도를 설정하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: 그렇기 때문에 이를 인상하거나 유예하지 못하면 지급 불이행의 위험이 있으며, 이는 금융 시장을 혼란에 빠뜨릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: 분열된 정부는 종종 부채 한도 투표를 긴장하게 만들었는데, 이는 집권하지 못한 정당이 지출 억제를 요구하기 위해 이 투표를 이용할 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: 역사적으로 각 대치 상황은 합의로 끝났지만, 합의는 때때로 예상된 마감 시한에 임박해서야 이루어졌으며, 2011년의 등급 강등은 아슬아슬한 위기조차 비용을 초래할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: 또한 분열된 정부가 적자를 확실하게 줄이지 못한다는 점도 주목할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: 지출 상한선과 협상된 합의가 때때로 지출 증가를 늦추기도 했지만, 사회보장, 메디케어, 의료 비용, 이자 지급과 같은 부채의 주요 원인들은 분열된 의회에서 거의 변경되지 않는데, 이는 보통 광범위한 정치적 합의가 필요하기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **어느 원이 뒤집히는가.** 새로운 하원 다수당은 지출 법안, 조사, 탄핵을 통제하고, 새로운 상원 다수당은 인준을 통제합니다.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **일정.** 정부 자금 지원, 만료되는 프로그램, 그리고 부채 한도 날짜는 자연스러운 압박 지점을 만듭니다.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **다수당의 규모.** 근소한 차이는 어느 정당이 이끌든 소수의 의원 그룹에게 과도한 영향력을 부여합니다.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **타협 의지.** 일부 분열된 의회는 중요한 초당적 법안을 만들어냈지만, 다른 의회는 대치 상황 외에는 거의 아무것도 만들어내지 못했습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: 분열된 의회가 자동으로 교착 상태를 의미하는 것은 아니며, 자동으로 위기를 의미하는 것도 아닙니다.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: 이는 워싱턴이 작동하는 방식을 변화시킵니다. 즉, 포괄적인 법안은 줄어들고, 마감 시한을 둘러싼 협상은 늘어나며, 행정부에 대한 조사는 강화되고, 인준 과정은 더 많은 논쟁을 겪게 됩니다.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: 중간선거를 고민하는 유권자들은 자신이 선호하는 정당이 어디인지뿐만 아니라, 어떤 종류의 워싱턴을 기대하는지도 자문해보는 것이 유용할 것입니다.

zh.title: 僵局还是最后期限政治？分裂的国会对开支、监督和债务意味着什么

segments.src: When voters go to the polls in November, one question sits underneath many others: who will control which chamber of Congress?
segments.tr: 当选民在11月进行投票时，许多问题背后都隐藏着一个核心问题：谁将控制国会的哪个院？

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: 如果众议院、参议院或两院落入与白宫不同的政党手中，华盛顿接下来的两年将会截然不同。

segments.src: History suggests that divided government rarely means "nothing happens."
segments.tr: 历史表明，分裂政府很少意味着“什么都不会发生”。

segments.src: It usually means that *different* things happen, and that most of them happen at the last minute.
segments.tr: 它通常意味着*不同*的事情会发生，而且其中大多数都发生在最后一刻。

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: 本说明旨在探讨过去的经验如何表明分裂的国会如何改变开支、监督、提名和国债。

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: 它不预测任何选举结果，也不偏袒任何政党。

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: 以下的规律在共和党和民主党多数派执政期间都曾出现过。

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## 分裂政府实际改变了什么

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: 根据宪法，一项法案必须以相同的形式通过两院，然后由总统签署。

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: 只有在两院均获得三分之二的投票通过，才能推翻否决权，这个门槛很少能达到。

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: 当一个政党控制白宫而另一个政党控制国会的一院时，双方对彼此的优先事项都拥有否决权。

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: 这会产生几个可预测的影响：

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **重大新立法变得更加困难。** 关于税收、医疗保健或气候的全面法案通常需要统一控制，或者至少需要一个罕见的跨党派联盟。

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **必须通过的法案获得了筹码。** 国会无法轻易跳过的措施，例如政府资金、国防政策和债务上限调整，成为谈判的主要工具。

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **监督加强。** 未掌握总统职位的政党获得了审查行政部门的工具。

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **人事争斗加剧。** 如果参议院和白宫由不同政党控制，确认任命可能会变得更慢且更具争议。

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## 开支：为什么最后期限主导一切

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: 国会本应在10月1日新财政年度开始前通过12项年度拨款法案。

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: 自1997财年以来，它从未按时完成这项工作。

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: 在近乎每一个近年里，立法者都依赖权宜之计的“持续决议”来维持机构运转，同时谈判仍在继续。

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: 分裂政府往往会加剧这种格局。

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: 由于任何一方都无法强加其预算，谈判被推向了最后期限，此时失败的代价变得显而易见。

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: 几次事件展示了各种可能的结果：

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011：** 在2010年中期选举产生分裂的国会之后，一场债务上限对峙以《预算控制法》告终，该法设定了开支上限和自动全面削减，被称为减赤机制。评级机构标准普尔当年夏天将美国信用评级下调，部分原因是对政治博弈的担忧。

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013：** 10月发生了一场持续16天的部分政府关门，当时的众议院由共和党控制，参议院和总统由民主党掌控。

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018–2019：** 持续35天的部分政府关门是有史以来最长的一次，始于共和党统一控制时期，并在2019年1月民主党夺取众议院控制权后继续。当年晚些时候的一项跨党派预算协议暂停了债务上限并设定了两年的开支水平。

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023：** 在共和党控制众议院、民主党掌控参议院和白宫的情况下，《财政责任法》暂停了债务上限并对部分开支设定了上限，避免了潜在的违约。

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: 经验教训并非分裂政府一定会导致政府关门。

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: 在几个案例中，它达成了统一政府未能达成的多年期预算协议。

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: 但通往这些协议的道路往往首先经历了政治博弈。

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## 监督：听证会、传票与调查

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: 某一院的多数党选择其委员会主席并制定其议程。

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: 委员会可以举行听证会、索取文件并发出传票。

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: 当反对党接管一院时，它通常会比同党多数派更具攻击性地利用这些工具来针对行政部门。

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: 众议院还拥有弹劾的宪法权力，参议院拥有审理弹劾的权力。

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: 这些是罕见而严肃的步骤，但只要控制权分裂，这种可能性就会改变政治气候。

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: 调查可以产生真正的效果，例如政策变更、辞职或新立法。

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: 它们也可能消耗原本可以用于立法的时间和注意力。

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: 支持者认为它们是对行政权力的重要制衡；批评者通常认为它们是政治表演。

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: 哪种观点适用通常取决于哪个政党正在接受调查，这提醒人们，两党在处于反对党地位时都使用过相同的工具。

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## 确认任命与法院

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: 参议院负责确认内阁官员、大使和联邦法官。

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: 自2013年和2017年的规则修改以来，大多数提名（包括最高法院提名）可以通过简单多数而非60票推进。

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: 这意味着控制参议院的政党对谁获得确认拥有巨大的权力。

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: 如果参议院和白宫分属不同阵营，预计会有更长的等待时间、更多被撤回的提名以及对代理官员的更大依赖。

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: 如果它们保持一致，确认通常会进展得更快，即使众议院处于反对党地位。

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: 这使得参议院的结果对司法和行政部门的任命尤为重要。

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## 债务：当最后期限遇到市场

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: 联邦债务已超过3万亿美元（注：原文为37 trillion），无论在经济好坏的年份，年度赤字都一直很大。

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: 法定债务上限并未授权新的开支。

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: 它限制了支付国会已经批准的义务所需的借款。

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: 正因为如此，未能提高或暂停它将带来错过付款的风险，这可能会扰乱金融市场。

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: 分裂政府经常使债务上限投票变得紧张，因为下台的政党可能会利用投票来要求节制开支。

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: 从历史上看，每一次对峙都以达成协议告终，但协议有时临近预计的最后期限才达成，2011年的评级下调表明，即使是险险过关也会带来代价。

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: 同样值得注意的是，分裂政府并不能可靠地减少赤字。

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: 开支上限和谈判达成的协议有时会减缓开支增长，但债务的主要驱动因素（例如社会保障、医疗保险、医疗成本和利息支付）在分裂的国会中很少发生改变，因为它们通常需要广泛的政治共识。

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## 需要关注什么

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **哪一院翻盘。** 新的众议院多数派控制开支法案、调查和弹劾；新的参议院多数派控制确认任命。

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **日程表。** 政府资金、即将到期的项目以及任何债务上限日期都会产生自然的压力点。

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **多数派的规模。** 狭窄的优势使一小群立法者拥有过大的影响力，无论哪个政党领导。

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **妥协的意愿。** 一些分裂的国会产生了重大的跨党派法律，而另一些国会除了对峙之外几乎没有什么成果。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: 分裂的国会并不自动意味着僵局，也不自动意味着危机。

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: 它确实改变了华盛顿的运作方式：更少全面的法律，更多围绕最后期限的谈判，对行政部门更多的审查，以及更多受争议的提名。

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: 权衡中期选举的选民可能会发现，不仅要问他们更喜欢哪个政党，还要问他们期望得到哪种华盛顿，这很有用。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成政治背书或财务建议。

segments.tr: जब मतदाता नवंबर में मतदान के लिए जाते हैं, तो कई अन्य सवालों के नीचे एक सवाल होता है: कांग्रेस के किस सदन पर किसका नियंत्रण होगा?

segments.tr: इसका आमतौर पर मतलब होता है कि *अलग-अलग* चीजें होती हैं, और उनमें से अधिकांश अंतिम समय में होती हैं।

segments.tr: यह स्पष्टकर्ता इस बात को देखता है कि पिछला अनुभव क्या कहता है कि कैसे एक विभाजित कांग्रेस खर्च, निगरानी, नामांकन और राष्ट्रीय ऋण को बदलती है।

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: यह किसी भी चुनाव परिणाम की भविष्यवाणी नहीं करता है और न ही किसी पार्टी का पक्ष लेता है।

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: नीचे दिए गए पैटर्न रिपब्लिकन और डेमोक्रेटिक दोनों बहुमतों के तहत दिखाई दिए हैं।

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## विभाजित सरकार वास्तव में क्या बदलती है

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: संविधान के तहत, एक विधेयक को दोनों सदनों से समान रूप से पारित होना चाहिए और फिर राष्ट्रपति द्वारा हस्ताक्षर किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: वीटो को केवल प्रत्येक सदन में दो-तिहाई वोट द्वारा ही पलटा जा सकता है, एक ऐसा सीमा जो शायद ही कभी पहुंचती है।

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: जब एक पार्टी व्हाइट हाउस को नियंत्रित करती है और दूसरी कांग्रेस के एक सदन को नियंत्रित करती है, तो प्रत्येक पक्ष दूसरे की प्राथमिकताओं पर वीटो रखता है।

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: इसके कुछ अनुमानित प्रभाव हैं:

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **बड़े नए कानून कठिन हो जाते हैं।** करों, स्वास्थ्य सेवा या जलवायु पर व्यापक विधेयकों को आमतौर पर एकीकृत नियंत्रण की आवश्यकता होती है, या कम से कम एक दुर्लभ द्विपक्षीय गठबंधन की।

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **अवश्य-पारित होने वाले विधेयक लाभ प्राप्त करते हैं।** ऐसे उपाय जिन्हें कांग्रेस आसानी से छोड़ नहीं सकती है, जैसे कि सरकारी फंडिंग, रक्षा नीति और ऋण-सीमा परिवर्तन, बातचीत के मुख्य वाहन बन जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **निगरानी तेज हो जाती है।** जो पार्टी राष्ट्रपति पद नहीं रखती है, वह कार्यकारी शाखा की जांच करने के लिए उपकरण प्राप्त करती है।

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **कार्मिक लड़ाइयाँ बढ़ती हैं।** यदि सीनेट और व्हाइट हाउस को अलग-अलग दलों द्वारा नियंत्रित किया जाता है, तो पुष्टिकरण धीमा और अधिक विवादित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## खर्च: क्यों समय सीमा शासन करती है

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस को 1 अक्टूबर को वित्तीय वर्ष शुरू होने से पहले 12 वार्षिक विनियोग विधेयक पारित करने चाहिए।

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: इसने वित्तीय वर्ष 1997 के बाद से समय पर उस काम को पूरा नहीं किया है।

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: लगभग हर हाल के वर्ष में, कानून निर्माताओं ने बातचीत जारी रहने के दौरान एजेंसियों को खुला रखने के लिए स्टॉपगैप "निरंतर प्रस्तावों" पर भरोसा किया है।

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: विभाजित सरकार इस पैटर्न को तेज करने की प्रवृत्ति रखती है।

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: बिना किसी पक्ष के अपने बजट को थोपने में सक्षम होने के कारण, बातचीत को समय सीमा की ओर धकेल दिया जाता है, जब विफलता की लागत दिखाई देने लगती है।

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: कई एपिसोड परिणामों की श्रेणी दिखाते हैं:

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011:** 2010 के मध्यावधि के बाद एक विभाजित कांग्रेस का उत्पादन हुआ, एक ऋण-सीमा गतिरोध बजट नियंत्रण अधिनियम के साथ समाप्त हुआ, जिसने खर्च कैप और स्वचालित चौतरफा कटौती निर्धारित की, जिसे सीक्वेस्टर के रूप में जाना जाता है। रेटिंग एजेंसी स्टैंडर्ड एंड पूअर्स ने उस गर्मियों में अमेरिकी क्रेडिट रेटिंग को डाउनग्रेड किया, आंशिक रूप से राजनीतिक ब्रिंकमैनशिप का हवाला देते हुए।

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013:** अक्टूबर में एक रिपब्लिकन हाउस और एक डेमोक्रेटिक सीनेट और राष्ट्रपति के साथ 16-दिन की आंशिक सरकार शटडाउन हुई।

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018–2019:** एक 35-दिन का आंशिक शटडाउन, अपने समय का सबसे लंबा, एकीकृत रिपब्लिकन नियंत्रण के तहत शुरू हुआ और जनवरी 2019 में डेमोक्रेट्स द्वारा हाउस लेने के बाद जारी रहा। उस वर्ष के अंत में एक द्विपक्षीय बजट समझौते ने ऋण सीमा को निलंबित कर दिया और दो साल के लिए खर्च के स्तर को निर्धारित किया।

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023:** एक रिपब्लिकन हाउस और एक डेमोक्रेटिक सीनेट और राष्ट्रपति के साथ, राजकोषीय उत्तरदायित्व अधिनियम ने ऋण सीमा को निलंबित कर दिया और कुछ खर्च पर कैप निर्धारित की, जिससे संभावित डिफ़ॉल्ट से बचा जा सके।

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: सबक यह नहीं है कि विभाजित सरकार हमेशा शटडाउन पैदा करती है।

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: कई मामलों में इसने बहुवर्षीय बजट सौदों का उत्पादन किया जो एकीकृत सरकार ने नहीं किया।

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: लेकिन उन सौदों का रास्ता अक्सर पहले ब्रिंकमैनशिप के माध्यम से चला गया।

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## निगरानी: सुनवाई, समन और जांच

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: एक सदन में बहुमत पार्टी अपने समिति के अध्यक्षों को चुनती है और उनके एजेंडे को निर्धारित करती है।

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: समितियां सुनवाई कर सकती हैं, दस्तावेज अनुरोध कर सकती हैं और समन जारी कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: जब विपक्षी पार्टी एक सदन पर कब्जा कर लेती है, तो यह आम तौर पर प्रशासन के खिलाफ इन उपकरणों का उपयोग एक ही पार्टी के बहुमत की तुलना में अधिक आक्रामक रूप से करती है।

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: हाउस के पास महाभियोग चलाने की संवैधानिक शक्ति भी है, और सीनेट के पास महाभियोग की कोशिश करने की शक्ति है।

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: ये दुर्लभ और गंभीर कदम हैं, लेकिन जब भी नियंत्रण विभाजित होता है, तो संभावना राजनीतिक माहौल को बदल देती है।

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: जांच के वास्तविक प्रभाव हो सकते हैं, जैसे नीति परिवर्तन, इस्तीफे या नए कानून।

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: वे समय और ध्यान भी उपभोग कर सकते हैं जो अन्यथा कानून बनाने में जा सकता है।

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: समर्थक उन्हें कार्यकारी शक्ति पर एक आवश्यक जांच के रूप में देखते हैं; आलोचक अक्सर उन्हें राजनीतिक थिएटर के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: कौन सा दृष्टिकोण लागू होता है यह अक्सर इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि किस पार्टी की जांच की जा रही है, एक याद दिलाता है कि दोनों पार्टियों ने एक ही उपकरणों का उपयोग किया है जब वे विपक्ष में थे।

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## पुष्टिकरण और अदालतें

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: सीनेट कैबिनेट अधिकारियों, राजदूतों और संघीय न्यायाधीशों की पुष्टि करता है।

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: 2013 और 2017 में नियम परिवर्तनों के बाद से, अधिकांश नामांकन, सुप्रीम कोर्ट के नामांकित व्यक्तियों सहित, 60 वोटों के बजाय एक साधारण बहुमत पर आगे बढ़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि सीनेट को नियंत्रित करने वाली पार्टी के पास इस बात पर पर्याप्त शक्ति है कि किसकी पुष्टि की जाती है।

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: यदि सीनेट और व्हाइट हाउस अलग-अलग हाथों में हैं, तो लंबी प्रतीक्षा, अधिक वापस लिए गए नामांकन और अभिनय अधिकारियों पर अधिक निर्भरता की अपेक्षा करें।

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: यदि वे संरेखित हैं, तो पुष्टिकरण तेजी से आगे बढ़ने की प्रवृत्ति रखते हैं, भले ही हाउस विपक्ष में हो।

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: यह न्यायिक और कार्यकारी-शाखा नियुक्तियों के लिए सीनेट के परिणाम को विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण बनाता है।

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## ऋण: जहां समय सीमा बाजारों से मिलती है

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: संघीय ऋण $37 ट्रिलियन से अधिक बढ़ गया है, और अच्छे और बुरे दोनों आर्थिक वर्षों में वार्षिक घाटा बड़ा रहा है।

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: सांविधिक ऋण सीमा नए खर्च को अधिकृत नहीं करती है।

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: यह उन दायित्वों के भुगतान के लिए आवश्यक उधार को कैप करता है जिन्हें कांग्रेस ने पहले ही मंजूरी दे दी है।

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: उसकी वजह से, इसे बढ़ाने या निलंबित करने में विफल रहने से छूटे हुए भुगतानों का जोखिम होता है, जो वित्तीय बाजारों को बाधित कर सकता है।

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: विभाजित सरकार ने अक्सर ऋण-सीमा वोटों को तनावपूर्ण बना दिया है, क्योंकि सत्ता से बाहर की पार्टी खर्च संयम की मांग करने के लिए वोट का उपयोग कर सकती है।

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: ऐतिहासिक रूप से, प्रत्येक गतिरोध एक सौदे के साथ समाप्त हुआ है, लेकिन सौदे कभी-कभी अनुमानित समय सीमा के करीब आ गए हैं, और 2011 का डाउनग्रेड यह दर्शाता है कि एक नज़दीकी मिस भी एक लागत उठा सकती है।

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: यह भी ध्यान देने योग्य है कि विभाजित सरकार मज़बूती से घाटे को कम नहीं करती है।

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: खर्च कैप और बातचीत किए गए सौदों ने कभी-कभी खर्च की वृद्धि को धीमा कर दिया है, लेकिन ऋण के प्रमुख चालकों, जैसे कि सामाजिक सुरक्षा, मेडिकेयर, स्वास्थ्य लागत और ब्याज भुगतान, को एक विभाजित कांग्रेस में शायद ही कभी बदला जाता है, क्योंकि उन्हें आमतौर पर व्यापक राजनीतिक समझौते की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **कौन सा सदन पलटता है।** एक नया हाउस बहुमत खर्च विधेयकों, जांच और महाभियोग को नियंत्रित करता है; एक नया सीनेट बहुमत पुष्टिकरण को नियंत्रित करता है।

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **कैलेंडर।** सरकारी फंडिंग, समाप्त होने वाले कार्यक्रम और कोई भी ऋण-सीमा तिथि प्राकृतिक दबाव बिंदु बनाती है।

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **बहुमत का आकार।** एक संकीर्ण मार्जिन कानून निर्माताओं के छोटे समूहों को अत्यधिक प्रभाव देता है, जो भी पार्टी नेतृत्व करती है।

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **समझौता करने की इच्छा।** कुछ विभाजित कांग्रेसों ने महत्वपूर्ण द्विपक्षीय कानूनों का उत्पादन किया है, जबकि अन्य ने गतिरोध के अलावा कुछ नहीं पैदा किया।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचली रेखा

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: एक विभाजित कांग्रेस स्वचालित रूप से ग्रिडलॉक नहीं है, और यह स्वचालित रूप से संकट नहीं है।

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: यह इस बात को बदलता है कि वाशिंगटन कैसे काम करता है: कम व्यापक कानून, समय सीमा के आसपास अधिक बातचीत, कार्यकारी शाखा की अधिक जांच, और अधिक विवादित नामांकन।

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: मध्यावधि का वजन करने वाले मतदाताओं को न केवल यह पूछना उपयोगी लग सकता है कि वे किस पार्टी को पसंद करते हैं, बल्कि यह भी कि वे वाशिंगटन के किस तरह के होने की उम्मीद करते हैं।

segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी के लिए है और इसमें राजनीतिक समर्थन या वित्तीय सलाह शामिल नहीं है।

segments.tr: आंकड़े और ऐतिहासिक विवरण संक्षेप में प्रस्तुत किए गए हैं और बदल सकते हैं; वर्तमान डेटा के लिए Congress.gov और कांग्रेसनल बजट ऑफिस जैसे आधिकारिक स्रोतों से परामर्श करें।*

es.title: Parálisis o gobierno por fecha límite? Lo que un Congreso dividido significaría para el gasto, la fiscalización y la deuda

segments.src: When voters go to the polls in November, one question sits underneath many others: who will control which chamber of Congress?
segments.tr: Cuando los votantes acudan a las urnas en noviembre, una pregunta subyace a muchas otras: ¿quién controlará qué cámara del Congreso?

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: Si la Cámara de Representantes, el Senado o ambos terminan en manos distintas a las de la Casa Blanca, los próximos dos años en Washington podrían ser muy diferentes.

segments.src: History suggests that divided government rarely means "nothing happens."
segments.tr: La historia sugiere que un gobierno dividido rara vez significa que "no pasa nada".

segments.src: It usually means that *different* things happen, and that most of them happen at the last minute.
segments.tr: Por lo general, significa que suceden *cosas diferentes* y que la mayoría de ellas ocurren en el último minuto.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo analiza lo que la experiencia pasada indica sobre cómo un Congreso dividido cambia el gasto, la fiscalización, los nombramientos y la deuda nacional.

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: No predice ningún resultado electoral ni favorece a ningún partido.

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: Los patrones a continuación se han presentado bajo mayorías tanto republicanas como demócratas.

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## Lo que un gobierno dividido realmente cambia

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: Según la Constitución, un proyecto de ley debe aprobarse en ambas cámaras en idéntica forma y luego ser firmado por el presidente.

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: Un veto solo puede ser anulado por una mayoría de dos tercios en cada cámara, un umbral que rara vez se alcanza.

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: Cuando un partido controla la Casa Blanca y el otro controla una cámara del Congreso, cada bando tiene capacidad de veto sobre las prioridades del otro.

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: Eso tiene algunos efectos predecibles:

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **Nuevas leyes importantes se vuelven más difíciles.** Las leyes de amplio alcance sobre impuestos, atención médica o clima suelen necesitar un control unificado, o al menos una coalición bipartidista poco común.

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **Las leyes de aprobación obligatoria ganan peso.** Las medidas que el Congreso no puede evitar fácilmente, como la financiación gubernamental, la política de defensa y los cambios en el límite de la deuda, se convierten en los principales vehículos de negociación.

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **La fiscalización se intensifica.** El partido que no detenta la presidencia obtiene herramientas para examinar de cerca al poder ejecutivo.

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **Los enfrentamientos por personal aumentan.** Si el Senado y la Casa Blanca están controlados por diferentes partidos, las confirmaciones pueden volverse más lentas y disputadas.

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## Gasto: Por qué mandan las fechas límite

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Se supone que el Congreso debe aprobar 12 proyectos de ley de asignaciones anuales antes de que comience el año fiscal el 1 de octubre.

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: No ha completado esa tarea a tiempo desde el año fiscal 1997.

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: En casi todos los años recientes, los legisladores han dependido de "resoluciones continuas" provisionales para mantener abiertas las agencias mientras continúan las conversaciones.

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: Un gobierno dividido tiende a agudizar este patrón.

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: Como ningún bando puede imponer su presupuesto, las negociaciones se empujan hacia las fechas límite, cuando el costo de fracasar se vuelve visible.

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: Varios episodios muestran la variedad de resultados:

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011:** Tras las elecciones de mitad de periodo de 2010 que produjeron un Congreso dividido, un enfrentamiento por el límite de la deuda terminó con la Ley de Control Presupuestario, que estableció topes de gasto y recortes automáticos generalizados, conocidos como el secuestro presupuestario. La agencia calificadora Standard & Poor's rebajó la calificación crediticia de EE. UU. ese verano, citando en parte el juego político al borde del abismo.

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013:** Un cierre parcial del gobierno de 16 días ocurrió en octubre, con una Cámara de Representantes republicana y un Senado y presidente demócratas.

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018–2019:** Un cierre parcial de 35 días, el más largo de su tipo, comenzó bajo el control republicano unificado y continuó después de que los demócratas tomaran la Cámara en enero de 2019. Un acuerdo presupuestario bipartidista más tarde ese año suspendió el límite de la deuda y fijó los niveles de gasto por dos años.

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023:** Con una Cámara de Representantes republicana y un Senado y presidente demócratas, la Ley de Responsabilidad Fiscal suspendió el límite de la deuda y estableció topes en algunos gastos, evitando un posible incumplimiento.

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: La lección no es que un gobierno dividido siempre produzca un cierre.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: En varios casos produjo acuerdos presupuestarios plurianuales que el gobierno unificado no logró.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: Pero el camino hacia esos acuerdos a menudo pasó primero por el juego al borde del abismo.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## Fiscalización: Audiencias, citaciones e investigaciones

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: El partido mayoritario en una cámara elige a los presidentes de sus comités y establece sus agendas.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: Los comités pueden celebrar audiencias, solicitar documentos y emitir citaciones.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: Cuando el partido de oposición toma el control de una cámara, por lo general utiliza estas herramientas de manera más agresiva contra la administración que lo que lo haría una mayoría del mismo partido.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: La Cámara de Representantes también posee el poder constitucional de someter a juicio político (impeachment), y el Senado posee el poder de juzgar dichos juicios.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: Estos son pasos raros y graves, pero la posibilidad cambia el clima político cada vez que el control está dividido.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: Las investigaciones pueden tener efectos reales, como cambios de política, renuncias o nueva legislación.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: También pueden consumir tiempo y atención que de otro modo se destinarían a la elaboración de leyes.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: Los partidarios las ven como un control esencial sobre el poder ejecutivo; los críticos a menudo las ven como teatro político.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: Qué perspectiva se aplica suele depender de qué partido esté siendo investigado, un recordatorio de que ambos partidos han utilizado las mismas herramientas cuando han estado en la oposición.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## Confirmaciones y los tribunales

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: El Senado confirma a los secretarios del gabinete, embajadores y jueces federales.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: Desde los cambios de reglas en 2013 y 2017, la mayoría de las nominaciones, incluidos los nominados a la Corte Suprema, pueden avanzar con una mayoría simple en lugar de 60 votos.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: Eso significa que el partido que controla el Senado tiene un poder sustancial sobre quién es confirmado.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: Si el Senado y la Casa Blanca están en manos diferentes, espere esperas más largas, más nominaciones retiradas y una mayor dependencia de funcionarios interinos.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: Si están alineados, las confirmaciones tienden a avanzar más rápido, incluso cuando la Cámara de Representantes está en la oposición.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: Esto hace que el resultado del Senado sea especialmente importante para los nombramientos judiciales y del poder ejecutivo.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## La deuda: Donde las fechas límite se encuentran con los mercados

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: La deuda federal ha superado los $37 billones, y los déficits anuales han sido grandes tanto en años económicos buenos como malos.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: El límite de deuda estatutario no autoriza nuevos gastos.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: Limita el endeudamiento necesario para pagar obligaciones que el Congreso ya ha aprobado.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: Debido a eso, no elevarlo o suspenderlo arriesga pagos perdidos, lo que podría perturbar los mercados financieros.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: El gobierno dividido a menudo ha hecho que las votaciones sobre el límite de la deuda sean tensas, ya que el partido fuera del poder puede usar la votación para exigir moderación en el gasto.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: Históricamente, cada enfrentamiento ha terminado con un acuerdo, pero los acuerdos a veces han llegado cerca de la fecha límite proyectada, y la rebaja de 2011 muestra que incluso un roce cercano puede tener un costo.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: También vale la pena señalar que el gobierno dividido no reduce de manera confiable los déficits.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: Los topes de gasto y los acuerdos negociados a veces han ralentizado el crecimiento del gasto, pero los principales impulsores de la deuda, como el Seguro Social, Medicare, los costos de salud y los pagos de intereses, rara vez se modifican en un Congreso dividido, porque por lo general requieren un amplio acuerdo político.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **Qué cámara cambia de manos.** Una nueva mayoría en la Cámara controla los proyectos de ley de gasto, las investigaciones y el juicio político; una nueva mayoría en el Senado controla las confirmaciones.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **El calendario.** La financiación del gobierno, los programas que expiran y cualquier fecha del límite de la deuda crean puntos de presión naturales.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **El tamaño de las mayorías.** Un margen estrecho otorga a pequeños grupos de legisladores una influencia desmedida, sin importar qué partido lidere.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **La disposición a comprometerse.** Algunos Congresos divididos han producido leyes bipartidistas significativas, mientras que otros no produjeron más que enfrentamientos.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: Un Congreso dividido no es automáticamente una parálisis, y no es automáticamente una crisis.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: Sí cambia la forma en que funciona Washington: menos leyes de amplio alcance, más negociación en torno a fechas límite, mayor escrutinio del poder ejecutivo y nombramientos más disputados.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: Los votantes que evalúan las elecciones de mitad de periodo pueden encontrar útil preguntarse no solo qué partido prefieren, sino también qué tipo de Washington esperan obtener.

segments.tr: الدرس ليس أن الحكومة المقسمة تنتج دائماً إغلاقاً.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: في عدة حالات، أنتجت صفقات ميزانية متعددة السنوات لم تفعلها الحكومة الموحدة.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: ولكن الطريق إلى تلك الصفقات غالباً ما مر عبر المناورات السياسية أولاً.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## الرقابة: الجلسات والاستدعاءات والتحقيقات

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: يختار حزب الأغلبية في الغرفة رؤساء لجانه ويحدد أجنداتها.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: يمكن للجان عقد جلسات استماع، وطلب المستندات وإصدار استدعاءات.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: عندما يتولى حزب المعارضة السيطرة على غرفة، فإنه عادة ما يستخدم هذه الأدوات بشكل أكثر عدوانية ضد الإدارة مما تفعل أغلبية من نفس الحزب.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: كما يمتلك مجلس النواب السلطة الدستورية للعزل، ويمتلك مجلس الشيوخ سلطة محاكمة العزولات.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: هذه خطوات نادرة وخطيرة، لكن احتمال تغيير المناخ السياسي كلما تم تقسيم السيطرة.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يكون للتحقيقات آثار حقيقية، مثل تغيير السياسات أو الاستقالات أو التشريعات الجديدة.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: يمكنهم أيضاً استهلاك الوقت والاهتمام الذي قد يذهب بدلاً من ذلك إلى التشريع.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: يرى المؤيدون أنهم فحص أساسي لسلطة التنفيذيين؛ وغالباً ما يراهم النقاد كمسرح سياسي.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: يعتمد الرأي الذي ينطبق غالباً على الحزب الذي يتم التحقيق معه، وهو تذكير بأن كلا الحزبين قد استخدما نفس الأدوات عندما كانا في المعارضة.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## التأكيدات والمحاكم

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: يؤكد مجلس الشيوخ مسؤولي مجلس الوزراء والسفراء والقضاة الفيدراليين.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: منذ تغييرات القواعد في عامي 2013 و2017، يمكن لمعظم الترشيحات، بما في ذلك المرشحين للمحكمة العليا، أن تتقدم على أغلبية بسيطة بدلاً من 60 صوتاً.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: هذا يعني أن الحزب الذي يسيطر على مجلس الشيوخ لديه سلطة كبيرة على من يحصل على التأكيد.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: إذا كان مجلس الشيوخ والبيت الأبيض في أيدٍ مختلفة، فتوقع انتظارات أطول، والمزيد من الترشيحات المسحوبة واعتماد أكبر على المسؤولين بالوكالة.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: إذا كانت متوافقة، تميل التأكيدات إلى التحرك بشكل أسرع، حتى عندما يكون مجلس النواب في المعارضة.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: هذا يجعل نتيجة مجلس الشيوخ مهمة بشكل خاص لتعيينات الفرع القضائي والتنفيذي.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## الدين: أين تلتقي المواعيد النهائية بالأسواق

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: لقد نما الدين الفيدرالي متجاوزاً 37 تريليون دولار، وكانت العجز السنوي كبيراً في سنوات الاقتصاد الجيدة والسيئة.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: حد الدين القانوني لا يفوض إنفاقاً جديداً.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: إنه يضع سقفاً للاقتراض اللازم لدفع الالتزامات التي وافق عليها الكونغرس بالفعل.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: بسبب ذلك، فإن الفشل في رفعها أو تعليقها يخاطر بالمدفوعات الفائتة، والتي يمكن أن تعطل الأسواق المالية.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: جعلت الحكومة المقسمة غالباً تصويتات حد الديون متوترة، حيث قد يستخدم الحزب خارج السلطة التصويت للمطالبة بضبط النفس في الإنفاق.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: تاريخياً، انتهى كل مواجهة بصفقة، لكن الصفقات وصلت أحياناً قريبًا من الموعد النهائي المتوقع، ويظهر خفض تصنيف 2011 أن حتى الاقتراب من الخطأ يمكن أن يحمل تكلفة.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: تجدر الإشارة أيضاً إلى أن الحكومة المقسمة لا تقلل بشكل موثوق من العجز.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: لقد أبطأت سقف الإنفاق والصفقات المفاوضة أحياناً من نمو الإنفاق، ولكن المحركات الرئيسية للدين، مثل الضمان الاجتماعي، والرعاية الطبية، والتكاليف الصحية ومدفوعات الفوائد، نادراً ما تتغير في كونغرس مقسم، لأنها تتطلب عادة اتفاقاً سياسياً واسعاً.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **التي تنقلب فيها الغرفة.** أغلبية مجلس النواب الجديدة تتحكم في فواتير الإنفاق والتحقيقات والعزل؛ وأغلبية مجلس الشيوخ الجديدة تتحكم في التأكيدات.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **التقويم.** تمويل الحكومة، والبرامج المنتهية الصلاحية وأي تاريخ لحد الدين تخلق نقاط ضغط طبيعية.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **حجم الأغلبية.** هامش ضيق يعطي مجموعات صغيرة من المشرعين نفوذاً مفرطاً، أياً كان الحزب الذي يقود.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **الرغبة في التسوية.** أنتجت بعض الكونغرسات المقسمة قوانين ثنائية الحزب هامة، بينما أنتجت أخرى القليل سوى المواجهات.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## خلاصة القول

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: الكونغرس المقسم ليس تلقائياً شللاً سياسياً، وليس تلقائياً أزمة.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: إنه يغير كيف تعمل واشنطن: قوانين شاملة أقل، والمزيد من المفاوضات حول المواعيد النهائية، والمزيد من التدقيق في الفرع التنفيذي، وترشيحات أكثر تنازعاً.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: قد يجد الناخبون الذين يزنون انتخابات التجديد النصفي أنه من المفيد أن يسألوا ليس فقط عن الحزب الذي يفضلونه، ولكن أيضاً عن نوع واشنطن التي يتوقعون الحصول عليها.
