segments.tr: *هذه المقالة للمعلومات العامة ولا تشكل تأييداً سياسياً أو نصيحة مالية.

segments.src: Figures and historical details are summarized and may change; consult official sources such as Congress.gov and the Congressional Budget Office for current data.*
segments.tr: الأرقام والتفاصيل التاريخية ملخصة وقد تتغير؛ استشر المصادر الرسمية مثل Congress.gov ومكتب ميزانية الكونغرس للحصول على البيانات الحالية.*

fr.title: Blocage ou gouvernement par échéance ? Ce qu'un Congrès divisé signifierait pour les dépenses, le contrôle et la dette

segments.src: When voters go to the polls in November, one question sits underneath many others: who will control which chamber of Congress?
segments.tr: Lorsque les électeurs se rendront aux urnes en novembre, une question sous-tendra de nombreuses autres : qui contrôlera quelle chambre du Congrès ?

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: Si la Chambre, le Sénat ou les deux se retrouvent entre des mains différentes de celles de la Maison-Blanche, les deux prochaines années à Washington pourraient être très différentes.

segments.src: History suggests that divided government rarely means "nothing happens."
segments.tr: L'histoire suggère qu'un gouvernement divisé signifie rarement que « rien ne se passe ».

segments.src: It usually means that *different* things happen, and that most of them happen at the last minute.
segments.tr: Cela signifie généralement que des choses *différentes* se produisent, et que la plupart d'entre elles se produisent à la dernière minute.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: Cette note explicative examine ce que l'expérience passée enseigne sur la manière dont un Congrès divisé modifie les dépenses, le contrôle, les nominations et la dette nationale.

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: Elle ne prédit aucun résultat électoral et ne favorise aucun parti.

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: Les tendances ci-dessous sont apparues sous des majorités républicaines et démocrates.

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'un gouvernement divisé change réellement

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: En vertu de la Constitution, un projet de loi doit être voté par les deux chambres dans des termes identiques, puis signé par le président.

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: Un veto ne peut être rejeté qu'à la majorité des deux tiers dans chaque chambre, un seuil rarement atteint.

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un parti contrôle la Maison-Blanche et que l'autre contrôle une chambre du Congrès, chaque camp détient un droit de veto sur les priorités de l'autre.

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: Cela entraîne quelques effets prévisibles :

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **De nouvelles lois d'envergure deviennent plus difficiles.** Les lois globales sur les impôts, la santé ou le climat nécessitent généralement un contrôle unifié, ou du moins une rare coalition bipartisane.

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **Les projets de loi indispensables gagnent en poids.** Les mesures que le Congrès ne peut facilement éluder, telles que le financement du gouvernement, la politique de défense et les modifications de la limite de la dette, deviennent les principaux véhicules de négociation.

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **Le contrôle s'intensifie.** Le parti qui ne détient pas la présidence obtient des outils pour scruter l'exécutif.

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **Les luttes de personnel s'accroissent.** Si le Sénat et la Maison-Blanche sont contrôlés par des partis différents, les confirmations peuvent devenir plus lentes et plus contestées.

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## Dépenses : pourquoi les échéances dictent la loi

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Le Congrès est censé voter 12 projets de loi de crédits annuels avant le début de l'exercice financier le 1er octobre.

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: Il n'a pas achevé cette tâche à temps depuis l'exercice 1997.

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: Presque chaque année récente, les législateurs se sont appuyés sur des « résolutions continues » provisoires pour maintenir les agences ouvertes pendant que les discussions se poursuivent.

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: Un gouvernement divisé tend à accentuer cette tendance.

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: Aucun des camps ne pouvant imposer son budget, les négociations sont repoussées vers les échéances, moment où le coût de l'échec devient visible.

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: Plusieurs épisodes illustrent la variété des résultats :

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011 :** Après que les élections de mi-mandat de 2010 ont donné lieu à un Congrès divisé, un bras de fer sur le plafond de la dette s'est soldé par le Budget Control Act, qui a fixé des plafonds de dépenses et des coupes automatiques généralisées, connues sous le nom de « sequester ». L'agence de notation Standard & Poor's a abaissé la note de crédit des États-Unis cet été-là, invoquant en partie le jeu politicien.

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013 :** Une fermeture partielle du gouvernement de 16 jours a eu lieu en octobre, avec une Chambre républicaine et un Sénat et un président démocrates.

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018–2019 :** Une fermeture partielle de 35 jours, la plus longue de son histoire, a débuté sous un contrôle républicain unifié et s'est poursuivie après la prise de contrôle de la Chambre par les démocrates en janvier 2019. Un accord budgétaire bipartisan conclu plus tard dans l'année a suspendu la limite de la dette et fixé les niveaux de dépenses pour deux ans.

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023 :** Avec une Chambre républicaine et un Sénat et un président démocrates, la Fiscal Responsibility Act a suspendu le plafond de la dette et fixé des plafonds sur certaines dépenses, évitant un défaut de paiement potentiel.

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: La leçon n'est pas qu'un gouvernement divisé provoque systématiquement une fermeture.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: Dans plusieurs cas, il a abouti à des accords budgétaires pluriannuels que le gouvernement unifié n'avait pas permis.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: Mais le chemin menant à ces accords passait souvent d'abord par le jeu de la corde raide.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## Contrôle : auditions, assignations et enquêtes

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: Le parti majoritaire dans une chambre choisit les présidents de ses commissions et fixe leurs ordres du jour.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: Les commissions peuvent tenir des auditions, demander des documents et émettre des assignations à comparaître.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: Lorsque le parti d'opposition prend le contrôle d'une chambre, il utilise généralement ces outils de manière plus agressive contre l'administration qu'une majorité du même parti ne le ferait.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: La Chambre détient également le pouvoir constitutionnel de mise en accusation (impeachment), et le Sénat détient le pouvoir de juger ces mises en accusation.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: Ce sont des mesures rares et graves, mais la possibilité modifie le climat politique chaque fois que le contrôle est partagé.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes peuvent avoir des effets réels, tels que des changements politiques, des démissions ou de nouvelles lois.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: Elles peuvent également consommer du temps et de l'attention qui pourraient autrement être consacrés à l'élaboration des lois.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: Leurs partisans y voient un contrôle essentiel du pouvoir exécutif ; les critiques y voient souvent du théâtre politique.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: Le point de vue adopté dépend souvent du parti qui fait l'objet de l'enquête, un rappel que les deux partis ont utilisé les mêmes outils lorsqu'ils étaient dans l'opposition.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## Confirmations et tribunaux

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: Le Sénat confirme les membres du cabinet, les ambassadeurs et les juges fédéraux.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: Depuis les changements de règles de 2013 et 2017, la plupart des nominations, y compris celles à la Cour suprême, peuvent progresser à la majorité simple plutôt qu'avec 60 voix.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: Cela signifie que le parti qui contrôle le Sénat dispose d'un pouvoir substantiel sur les personnes confirmées.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: Si le Sénat et la Maison-Blanche sont aux mains de camps différents, il faut s'attendre à des attente plus longues, à davantage de nominations retirées et à un plus grand recours à des responsables intérimaires.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: S'ils sont alignés, les confirmations ont tendance à avancer plus rapidement, même lorsque la Chambre est dans l'opposition.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: Cela rend le résultat du Sénat particulièrement important pour les nominations judiciaires et exécutives.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## La dette : quand les échéances rencontrent les marchés

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: La dette fédérale a dépassé les 37 000 milliards de dollars, et les déficits annuels ont été importants tant dans les bonnes que dans les mauvaises années économiques.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: Le plafond légal de la dette n'autorise pas de nouvelles dépenses.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: Il plafonne les emprunts nécessaires pour payer les obligations que le Congrès a déjà approuvées.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: De ce fait, ne pas relever ou suspendre ce plafond risque d'entraîner des paiements manqués, ce qui pourrait perturber les marchés financiers.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: Un gouvernement divisé a souvent rendu les votes sur le plafond de la dette tendus, le parti hors du pouvoir pouvant utiliser ce vote pour exiger une modération des dépenses.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: Historiquement, chaque bras de fer s'est terminé par un accord, mais ces accords sont parfois arrivés près de l'échéance prévue, et la dégradation de 2011 montre que même un faux pas de justesse peut avoir un coût.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: Il convient également de noter qu'un gouvernement divisé ne réduit pas de manière fiable les déficits.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: Les plafonds de dépenses et les accords négociés ont parfois ralenti la croissance des dépenses, mais les principaux moteurs de la dette, tels que la Sécurité sociale, Medicare, les coûts de la santé et les paiements d'intérêts, sont rarement modifiés dans un Congrès divisé, car ils nécessitent généralement un large accord politique.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## À surveiller

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **Quelle chambre bascule.** Une nouvelle majorité à la Chambre contrôle les projets de loi de dépenses, les enquêtes et l'impeachment ; une nouvelle majorité au Sénat contrôle les confirmations.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **Le calendrier.** Le financement du gouvernement, l'expiration des programmes et toute date liée au plafond de la dette créent des points de pression naturels.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **La taille des majorités.** Une marge étroite donne à de petits groupes de législateurs une influence démesurée, quel que soit le parti au pouvoir.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **La volonté de compromis.** Certains Congrès divisés ont produit des lois bipartisanes importantes, tandis que d'autres n'ont produit que peu de choses hormis des affrontements.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: Un Congrès divisé n'est pas automatiquement synonyme de blocage, ni automatiquement de crise.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: Cela modifie la façon dont Washington fonctionne : moins de lois d'envergure, plus de négociations autour des échéances, plus de surveillance de l'exécutif et plus de nominations contestées.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: Les électeurs qui pèsent les élections de mi-mandat trouveront peut-être utile de se demander non seulement quel parti ils préfèrent, mais aussi quel type de Washington ils s'attendent à obtenir.

pt.title: Impasses ou Governo por Prazos? O que um Congresso Dividido Significaria para Gastos, Fiscalização e a Dívida

segments.src: When voters go to the polls in November, one question sits underneath many others: who will control which chamber of Congress?
segments.tr: Quando os eleitores vão às urnas em novembro, uma pergunta fica subjacente a muitas outras: quem controlará qual câmara do Congresso?

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: Se a Câmara, o Senado ou ambos acabarem em mãos diferentes das da Casa Blanca, os próximos dois anos em Washington podem ser muito diferentes.

segments.src: History suggests that divided government rarely means "nothing happens."
segments.tr: A história sugere que um governo dividido raramente significa "nada acontece".

segments.src: It usually means that *different* things happen, and that most of them happen at the last minute.
segments.tr: Geralmente significa que *coisas diferentes* acontecem, e que a maioria delas acontece de última hora.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: Este artigo explicativo analisa o que a experiência passada diz sobre como um Congresso dividido altera gastos, fiscalização, nomeações e a dívida nacional.

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: Ele não prevê nenhum resultado eleitoral nem favorece nenhum partido.

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: Os padrões abaixo apareceram sob maiorias tanto republicanas quanto democratas.

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## O que um Governo Dividido Realmente Altera

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: Sob a Constituição, um projeto de lei deve ser aprovado em ambas as câmaras em forma idêntica e depois ser assinado pelo presidente.

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: Um veto só pode ser derrubado por uma votação de dois terços em cada câmara, um limite que raramente é alcançado.

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: Quando um partido controla a Casa Branca e o outro controla uma câmara do Congresso, cada lado detém um poder de veto sobre as prioridades do outro.

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: Isso tem alguns efeitos previsíveis:

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **Novas grandes leis tornam-se mais difíceis.** Projetos de lei abrangentes sobre impostos, saúde ou clima geralmente precisam de controle unificado, ou pelo menos de uma rara coalizão bipartidária.

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **Projetos essenciais ganham poder de barganha.** Medidas que o Congresso não pode ignorar facilmente, como financiamento governamental, política de defesa e alterações no limite da dívida, tornam-se os principais veículos para negociação.

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **A fiscalização se intensifica.** O partido que não detém a presidência ganha ferramentas para examinar minuciosamente o poder executivo.

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **Conflitos de pessoal aumentam.** Se o Senado e a Casa Branca forem controlados por partidos diferentes, as confirmações podem se tornar mais lentas e contestadas.

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## Gastos: Por que os Prazos Mandam

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: O Congresso deve aprovar 12 projetos de dotações anuais antes que o ano fiscal comece em 1 de outubro.

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: Ele não conclui esse trabalho no prazo desde o ano fiscal de 1997.

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: Em quase todos os anos recentes, os legisladores confiaram em "resoluções contínuas" de emergência para manter as agências abertas enquanto as negociações continuam.

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: Um governo dividido tende a acentuar esse padrão.

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: Com nenhum dos lados capaz de impor seu orçamento, as negociações são empurradas para os prazos finais, quando o custo do fracasso se torna visível.

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: Vários episódios mostram a gama de resultados:

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011:** Após as eleições de meio de mandato de 2010 produzirem um Congresso dividido, um impasse no limite da dívida terminou com a Lei de Controle Orçamentário, que estabeleceu tetos de gastos e cortes automáticos gerais, conhecidos como o *sequester*. A agência de classificação de risco Standard & Poor's rebaixou a nota de crédito dos EUA naquele verão, citando em parte o jogo político perigoso.

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013:** Uma paralisação parcial do governo de 16 dias ocorreu em outubro, com uma Câmara republicana e um Senado e presidente democratas.

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018–2019:** Uma paralisação parcial de 35 dias, a mais longa de seu tempo, começou sob controle republicano unificado e continuou após os democratas assumirem a Câmara em janeiro de 2019. Um acordo orçamentário bipartidário mais tarde naquele ano suspendeu o limite da dívida e definiu os níveis de gastos por dois anos.

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023:** Com uma Câmara republicana e um Senado e presidente democratas, a Lei de Responsabilidade Fiscal suspendeu o limite da dívida e estabeleceu tetos para alguns gastos, evitando uma potencial inadimplência.

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: A lição não é que o governo dividido sempre produza uma paralisação.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: Em vários casos, produziu acordos orçamentários plurianuais que o governo unificado não produziu.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: Mas o caminho para esses acordos frequentemente passou primeiro pelo jogo político arriscado.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## Fiscalização: Audiências, Intimações e Investigações

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: O partido majoritário em uma câmara escolhe os presidentes de suas comissões e define suas agendas.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: As comissões podem realizar audiências, solicitar documentos e emitir intimações.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: Quando o partido de oposição assume uma câmara, ele normalmente usa essas ferramentas de forma mais agressiva contra a administração do que faria uma maioria do mesmo partido.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: A Câmara também detém o poder constitucional de iniciar um impeachment, e o Senado detém o poder de julgar os impeachments.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: Estes são passos raros e sérios, mas a possibilidade altera o clima político sempre que o controle está dividido.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: As investigações podem ter efeitos reais, como mudanças políticas, renúncias ou nova legislação.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: Elas também podem consumir tempo e atenção que poderiam ser direcionados à elaboração de leis.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: Os apoiadores as veem como um freio essencial ao poder executivo; os críticos frequentemente as veem como teatro político.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: Qual visão se aplica geralmente depende de qual partido está sendo investigado, um lembrete de que ambos os partidos usaram as mesmas ferramentas quando estavam na oposição.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## Confirmações e os Tribunais

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: O Senado confirma oficiais de gabinete, embaixadores e juízes federais.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: Desde as mudanças nas regras em 2013 e 2017, a maioria das nomeações, incluindo indicados para a Suprema Corte, pode avançar por maioria simples em vez de 60 votos.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: Isso significa que o partido que controla o Senado tem substancial poder sobre quem é confirmado.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: Se o Senado e a Casa Branca estiverem em mãos diferentes, espere esperas mais longas, mais nomeações retiradas e maior dependência de oficiais interinos.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: Se estiverem alinhados, as confirmações tendem a avançar mais rápido, mesmo quando a Câmara está na oposição.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: Isso torna o resultado do Senado especialmente importante para nomeações judiciais e do poder executivo.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## A Dívida: Onde os Prazos Encontram os Mercados

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: A dívida federal ultrapassou 37 trilhões de dólares, e os déficits anuais têm sido grandes tanto em anos econômicos bons quanto ruins.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: O limite estatutário da dívida não autoriza novos gastos.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: Ele limita o endividamento necessário para pagar obrigações que o Congresso já aprovou.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: Por causa disso, deixar de elevá-lo ou suspendê-lo arrisca pagamentos perdidos, o que poderia perturbar os mercados financeiros.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: O governo dividido frequentemente tornou as votações sobre o limite da dívida tensas, uma vez que o partido fora do poder pode usar a votação para exigir contenção de gastos.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: Historicamente, cada impasse terminou com um acordo, mas os acordos às vezes chegaram perto do prazo projetado, e o rebaixamento de 2011 mostra que até mesmo um quase fracasso pode ter um custo.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: Também vale a pena notar que o governo dividido não reduz os déficits de forma confiável.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: Tetos de gastos e acordos negociados às vezes desaceleraram o crescimento dos gastos, mas os principais impulsionadores da dívida, como a Previdência Social, o Medicare, custos de saúde e pagamentos de juros, raramente são alterados em um Congresso dividido, porque geralmente exigem amplo acordo político.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## O Que Observar

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **Qual câmara muda de lado.** Uma nova maioria na Câmara controla projetos de gastos, investigações e impeachment; uma nova maioria no Senado controla as confirmações.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **O calendário.** Financiamento governamental, programas expirando e qualquer data de limite da dívida criam pontos de pressão naturais.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **O tamanho das maiorias.** Uma margem estreita dá a pequenos grupos de legisladores uma influência desproporcional, seja qual for o partido que lidera.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **Disposição para compromisso.** Alguns congressos divididos produziram leis bipartidárias significativas, enquanto outros produziram pouco além de impasses.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Conclusão

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: Um Congresso dividido não é automaticamente um impasse, e não é automaticamente uma crise.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: Ele altera a forma como Washington funciona: menos leis abrangentes, mais negociação em torno de prazos, mais escrutínio do poder executivo e mais nomeações contestadas.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: Os eleitores que pesam as eleições de meio de mandato podem achar útil perguntar não apenas qual partido preferem, mas também que tipo de Washington esperam obter.

segments.tr: Ketika para pemilih pergi ke tempat pemungutan suara pada bulan November, satu pertanyaan mendasari banyak pertanyaan lainnya: siapa yang akan mengendalikan kamar mana dari Kongres?

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: Jika DPR, Senat, atau keduanya berakhir di tangan yang berbeda dari Gedung Putih, dua tahun ke depan di Washington bisa terlihat sangat berbeda.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini melihat apa kata pengalaman masa lalu tentang bagaimana Kongres yang terpecah mengubah pengeluaran, pengawasan, penunjukan, dan utang nasional.

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Sebenarnya Diubah oleh Pemerintahan yang Terbelah

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:

segments.tr: - **RUU yang wajib disahkan mendapatkan daya tawar.** Langkah-langkah yang tidak dapat dengan mudah dilewati oleh Kongres, seperti pendanaan pemerintah, kebijakan pertahanan, dan perubahan batas utang, menjadi kendaraan utama untuk negosiasi.

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **Pengawasan semakin intensif.** Partai yang tidak memegang kekuasaan kepresidenan mendapatkan alat untuk mengawasi cabang eksekutif.

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **Pertarungan personel semakin meningkat.** Jika Senat dan Gedung Putih dikendalikan oleh partai yang berbeda, konfirmasi dapat menjadi lebih lambat dan lebih diperebutkan.

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## Pengeluaran: Mengapa Batas Waktu Menjadi Aturan

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Kongres seharusnya mengesahkan 12 RUU alokasi tahunan sebelum tahun fiskal dimulai pada tanggal 1 Oktober.

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: Mereka belum menyelesaikan tugas itu tepat waktu sejak tahun fiskal 1997.

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: Di hampir setiap tahun terakhir, para legislator mengandalkan "resolusi lanjutan" sementara untuk menjaga agar badan-badan tetap buka sementara pembicaraan terus berlanjut.

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: Pemerintahan yang terbelah cenderung mempertajam pola ini.

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: Dengan tidak adanya pihak yang mampu memaksakan anggarannya, negosiasi didorong menuju batas waktu, ketika biaya kegagalan menjadi terlihat.

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: Beberapa episode menunjukkan kisaran hasil:

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.

Lembaga pemeringkat Standard & Poor's menurunkan peringkat kredit AS musim panas itu, sebagian mengutip pertikaian politik.

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013:** Penutupan sebagian pemerintah selama 16 hari terjadi pada bulan Oktober, dengan DPR dari Partai Republik serta Senat dan presiden dari Partai Demokrat.

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018–2019:** Penutupan sebagian selama 35 hari, yang terpanjang pada masanya, dimulai di bawah kendali Partai Republik yang bersatu dan berlanjut setelah Partai Demokrat mengambil alih DPR pada Januari 2019. Kesepakatan anggaran bipartisan akhir tahun itu menangguhkan batas utang dan menetapkan tingkat pengeluaran selama dua tahun.

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023:** Dengan DPR dari Partai Republik serta Senat dan presiden dari Partai Demokrat, Undang-Undang Tanggung Jawab Fiskal menangguhkan batas utang dan menetapkan batasan pada beberapa pengeluaran, menghindari potensi gagal bayar.

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: Pelajaran yang dapat diambil bukanlah bahwa pemerintahan yang terbelah selalu menghasilkan penutupan pemerintahan.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa kasus, hal itu menghasilkan kesepakatan anggaran multi-tahun yang tidak dilakukan oleh pemerintahan yang bersatu.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: Namun jalan menuju kesepakatan tersebut sering kali melalui pertikaian terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## Pengawasan: Sidang, Panggilan Pengadilan, dan Investigasi

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: Partai mayoritas di suatu kamar memilih ketua komite dan menetapkan agenda mereka.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: Komite dapat mengadakan sidang, meminta dokumen, dan mengeluarkan panggilan pengadilan.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: Ketika partai oposisi mengambil alih suatu kamar, mereka biasanya menggunakan alat-alat ini secara lebih agresif terhadap pemerintahan daripada yang dilakukan oleh mayoritas dari partai yang sama.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: DPR juga memegang kekuasaan konstitusional untuk memakzulkan, dan Senat memegang kekuasaan untuk mengadili pemakzulan.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: Ini adalah langkah-langkah yang jarang dan serius, tetapi kemungkinan tersebut mengubah iklim politik setiap kali kendali terpecah.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: Investigasi dapat berdampak nyata, seperti perubahan kebijakan, pengunduran diri, atau undang-undang baru.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: Mereka juga dapat menyita waktu dan perhatian yang seharusnya dialokasikan untuk pembuatan undang-undang.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: Pendukung melihatnya sebagai pemeriksaan penting terhadap kekuasaan eksekutif; para kritikus sering melihatnya sebagai teater politik.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: Pandangan mana yang berlaku sering kali bergantung pada partai mana yang sedang diselidiki, sebuah pengingat bahwa kedua partai telah menggunakan alat yang sama ketika mereka berada di oposisi.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## Konfirmasi dan Pengadilan

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: Senat mengonfirmasi pejabat kabinet, duta besar, dan hakim federal.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: Sejak perubahan aturan pada tahun 2013 dan 2017, sebagian besar pencalonan, termasuk calon Mahkamah Agung, dapat maju dengan mayoritas sederhana daripada 60 suara.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: Itu berarti partai yang menguasai Senat memiliki kekuasaan besar atas siapa yang mendapatkan konfirmasi.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: Jika Senat dan Gedung Putih berada di tangan yang berbeda, harapkan waktu tunggu yang lebih lama, lebih banyak pencalonan yang ditarik, dan ketergantungan yang lebih besar pada pejabat pelaksana tugas.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: Jika mereka sejalan, konfirmasi cenderung bergerak lebih cepat, bahkan ketika DPR berada di pihak oposisi.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: Hal ini membuat hasil Senat sangat penting untuk penunjukan peradilan dan cabang eksekutif.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## Utang: Tempat Bertemunya Batas Waktu dengan Pasar

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: Utang federal telah tumbuh melewati $37 triliun, dan defisit tahunan telah besar di tahun-tahun ekonomi yang baik maupun buruk.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: Batas utang undang-undang tidak mengesahkan pengeluaran baru.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: Ini membatasi pinjaman yang diperlukan untuk membayar kewajiban yang telah disetujui oleh Kongres.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, kegagalan untuk menaikkan atau menangguhkannya berisiko menyebabkan pembayaran terlewat, yang dapat mengganggu pasar keuangan.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: Pemerintahan yang terbelah sering kali membuat pemungutan suara batas utang menjadi tegang, karena partai yang tidak berkuasa dapat menggunakan pemungutan suara tersebut untuk menuntut pembatasan pengeluaran.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: Secara historis, setiap kebuntuan telah berakhir dengan kesepakatan, tetapi kesepakatan tersebut kadang-kadang tiba mendekati batas waktu yang diproyeksikan, dan penurunan peringkat tahun 2011 menunjukkan bahwa bahkan nyaris meleset pun dapat membawa biaya.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: Perlu dicatat juga bahwa pemerintahan yang terbelah tidak secara andal mengurangi defisit.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: Batasan pengeluaran dan kesepakatan yang dirundingkan terkadang memperlambat pertumbuhan pengeluaran, tetapi pendorong utama utang, seperti Jaminan Sosial, Medicare, biaya kesehatan, dan pembayaran bunga, jarang diubah dalam Kongres yang terpecah, karena biasanya memerlukan kesepakatan politik yang luas.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **Kamar mana yang berbalik.** Mayoritas DPR baru mengendalikan RUU pengeluaran, investigasi, dan pemakzulan; mayoritas Senat baru mengendalikan konfirmasi.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **Kalender.** Pendanaan pemerintah, program yang akan kedaluwarsa, dan tanggal batas utang apa pun menciptakan titik tekanan alami.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **Ukuran mayoritas.** Margin yang sempit memberikan kelompok kecil legislator pengaruh yang besar, partai mana pun yang memimpin.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **Kesediaan untuk berkompromi.** Beberapa Kongres yang terbelah telah menghasilkan undang-undang bipartisan yang signifikan, sementara yang lain menghasilkan sedikit hal selain kebuntuan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: Kongres yang terbelah bukanlah secara otomatis kebuntuan, dan itu bukan secara otomatis sebuah krisis.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: Hal itu memang mengubah cara kerja Washington: lebih sedikit undang-undang sapu jagat, lebih banyak negosiasi seputar batas waktu, lebih banyak pengawasan terhadap cabang eksekutif, dan lebih banyak pencalonan yang diperebutkan.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: Para pemilih yang mempertimbangkan pemilu sela mungkin merasa berguna untuk menanyakan tidak hanya partai mana yang mereka lebih sukai, tetapi juga Washington seperti apa yang mereka harapkan.

ja.title: 議회의 기능 마비인가, 아니면 마감 시한에 쫓기는 정치인가? 여야가 갈린 의회가 지출, 감독, 국가 부채에 미치는 의미

segments.src: When voters go to the polls in November, one question sits underneath many others: who will control which chamber of Congress?
segments.tr: 11월 유권자들의 투표장 향방 아래에는 많은 질문이 깔려 있습니다. 과연 어느 당이 의회의 어느 원을 장악할 것인가 하는 점입니다.

segments.src: If the House, the Senate, or both end up in different hands from the White House, the next two years in Washington could look very different.
segments.tr: 하원이나 상원, 혹은 양원 모두가 백악관과 다른 정당에 의해 장악된다면 워싱턴의 향후 2년은 크게 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: History suggests that divided government rarely means "nothing happens."
segments.tr: 역사는 분점 정부가 결코 "아무 일도 일어나지 않는다"는 것을 의미하지는 않는다는 점을 시사합니다.

segments.src: It usually means that *different* things happen, and that most of them happen at the last minute.
segments.tr: 보통은 *다른* 일들이 일어나며, 그 대부분이 마지막 순간에 발생한다는 것을 뜻합니다.

segments.src: This explainer looks at what past experience says about how a split Congress changes spending, oversight, nominations and the national debt.
segments.tr: 이 해설서는 과거의 경험을 바탕으로 분열된 의회가 지출, 감독, 인선 및 국가 부채를 어떻게 변화시키는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: It does not predict any election result or favor any party.
segments.tr: 특정 선거 결과를 예측하거나 어느 정당을 지지하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: The patterns below have appeared under both Republican and Democratic majorities.
segments.tr: 아래의 패턴들은 공화당과 민주당 다수당 시기 모두에서 나타났습니다.

segments.src: ## What Divided Government Actually Changes
segments.tr: ## 분점 정부가 실제로 바꾸는 것

segments.src: Under the Constitution, a bill must pass both chambers in identical form and then be signed by the president.
segments.tr: 헌법상 법안은 양원을 동일한 문구로 통과한 후 대통령의 서명을 받아야 합니다.

segments.src: A veto can be overridden only by a two-thirds vote in each chamber, a threshold that is rarely reached.
segments.tr: 거부권은 각 원에서 3분의 2 이상이 찬성해야만 무효화할 수 있으며, 이 문턱은 도달하기 어렵습니다.

segments.src: When one party controls the White House and the other controls a chamber of Congress, each side holds a veto over the other's priorities.
segments.tr: 한 정당이 백악관을 장악하고 다른 정당이 의회의 한 원을 장악할 때, 각 측은 상대방의 우선순위에 대해 거부권을 행사할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That has a few predictable effects:
segments.tr: 이는 몇 가지 예측 가능한 영향을 미칩니다:

segments.src: - **Big new legislation becomes harder.** Sweeping bills on taxes, health care or climate usually need unified control, or at least a rare bipartisan coalition.
segments.tr: - **새로운 대규모 입법이 더 어려워집니다.** 세제, 의료, 기후에 관한 광범위한 법안은 대개 통합된 통제나 최소한 드문 초당파적 연합이 필요합니다.

segments.src: - **Must-pass bills gain leverage.** Measures that Congress cannot easily skip, such as government funding, defense policy and debt-limit changes, become the main vehicles for negotiation.
segments.tr: - **반드시 통과되어야 하는 법안들이 협상의 지렛대 역할을 합니다.** 정부 예산안, 국방 정책, 부채 한도 변경 등 의회가 쉽게 건너뛸 수 없는 조치들이 협상의 주요 수단이 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Oversight intensifies.** The party that does not hold the presidency gains tools to scrutinize the executive branch.
segments.tr: - **감독이 강화됩니다.** 대통령직을 잡지 못한 정당은 행정부를 면밀히 조사할 수 있는 수단을 얻게 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Personnel fights grow.** If the Senate and the White House are controlled by different parties, confirmations can become slower and more contested.
segments.tr: - **인사 청문회 싸움이 격화됩니다.** 상원과 백악관이 다른 정당에 의해 장악될 경우, 인준이 더 느려지고 논란이 커질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Spending: Why Deadlines Rule
segments.tr: ## 지출: 왜 마감 시한이 지배하는가

segments.src: Congress is supposed to pass 12 annual appropriations bills before the fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: 의회는 10월 1일 회계연도가 시작되기 전에 12개의 연례 세출법안을 통과시켜야 합니다.

segments.src: It has not completed that job on time since fiscal year 1997.
segments.tr: 1997 회계연도 이후로 제때 그 임무를 완수한 적이 없습니다.

segments.src: In nearly every recent year, lawmakers have relied on stopgap "continuing resolutions" to keep agencies open while talks continue.
segments.tr: 최근 거의 매년 의원들은 협상이 계속되는 동안 기관들을 계속 열어두기 위해 임시 예산안인 "계속 결의안"에 의존해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Divided government tends to sharpen this pattern.
segments.tr: 분점 정부는 이러한 경향을 더욱 뚜렷하게 만드는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: With neither side able to impose its budget, negotiations are pushed toward deadlines, when the cost of failing becomes visible.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽도 자신들의 예산을 강제할 수 없기 때문에, 실패의 대가가 눈에 보이게 되는 마감 시한을 향해 협상이 밀려나게 됩니다.

segments.src: Several episodes show the range of outcomes:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 사례는 다양한 결과를 보여줍니다:

segments.src: - **2011:** After the 2010 midterms produced a split Congress, a debt-limit standoff ended with the Budget Control Act, which set spending caps and automatic across-the-board cuts, known as the sequester. Rating agency Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. credit rating that summer, citing in part the political brinkmanship.
segments.tr: - **2011년:** 2010년 중간선거로 분열된 의회가 탄생한 후, 부채 한도 대치가 예산통제법으로 끝났으며, 이 법은 지출 상한선과 시퀘스터로 알려진 자동 전면 삭감을 설정했습니다. 신용평가사 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)는 정치적 줄다리기를 부분적인 이유로 꼽으며 그해 여름 미국의 신용등급을 강등했습니다.

segments.src: - **2013:** A 16-day partial government shutdown occurred in October, with a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president.
segments.tr: - **2013년:** 공화당이 하원을, 민주당이 상원과 대통령을 장악한 상태에서 10월에 16일간의 부분적 정부 업무 중단(셧다운)이 발생했습니다.

segments.src: - **2018–2019:** A 35-day partial shutdown, the longest of its time, began under unified Republican control and continued after Democrats took the House in January 2019. A bipartisan budget deal later that year suspended the debt limit and set spending levels for two years.
segments.tr: - **2018~2019년:** 당시 최장 기간인 35일간의 부분적 셧다운이 공화당의 단독 통제 하에 시작되었고 2019년 1월 민주당이 하원을 장악한 후에도 계속되었습니다. 그해 후반의 초당파적 예산 합의로 부채 한도가 유예되고 2년간의 지출 수준이 설정되었습니다.

segments.src: - **2023:** With a Republican House and a Democratic Senate and president, the Fiscal Responsibility Act suspended the debt limit and set caps on some spending, avoiding a potential default.
segments.tr: - **2023년:** 공화당 하원, 민주당 상원과 대통령 체제에서 재정책임법이 부채 한도를 유예하고 일부 지출 상한선을 설정하여 잠재적인 디폴트를 피했습니다.

segments.src: The lesson is not that divided government always produces a shutdown.
segments.tr: 교훈은 분점 정부가 항상 셧다운을 초래한다는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: In several cases it produced multiyear budget deals that unified government did not.
segments.tr: 여러 경우에 분점 정부는 통합 정부가 해내지 못한 수년 짜리 예산 합의를 이끌어냈습니다.

segments.src: But the route to those deals often ran through brinkmanship first.
segments.tr: 그러나 그러한 합의에 이르는 길은 대개 줄다리기를 먼저 거쳤습니다.

segments.src: ## Oversight: Hearings, Subpoenas and Investigations
segments.tr: ## 감독: 청문회, 소환장, 조사

segments.src: The majority party in a chamber chooses its committee chairs and sets their agendas.
segments.tr: 의회 내 다수당은 상임위원장을 선출하고 의제를 설정합니다.

segments.src: Committees can hold hearings, request documents and issue subpoenas.
segments.tr: 위원회는 청문회를 개최하고, 문서를 요구하며, 소환장을 발부할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: When the opposition party takes over a chamber, it typically uses these tools more aggressively against the administration than a same-party majority would.
segments.tr: 야당이 의원의 한 원을 장악하면, 동일 정당의 다수당일 때보다 행정부를 상대로 이러한 수단을 더 공격적으로 사용하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: The House also holds the constitutional power to impeach, and the Senate holds the power to try impeachments.
segments.tr: 하원은 또한 탄핵 소추권을 가지며, 상원은 탄핵 심판권을 가집니다.

segments.src: These are rare and serious steps, but the possibility changes the political climate whenever control is split.
segments.tr: 이는 드물고 진지한 조치이지만, 통제권이 나뉠 때마다 정치적 분위기를 변화시킵니다.

segments.src: Investigations can have real effects, such as policy changes, resignations or new legislation.
segments.tr: 조사는 정책 변경, 사퇴, 새로운 입법 등 실질적인 결과를 가져올 수 있습니다.

segments.src: They can also consume time and attention that might otherwise go to lawmaking.
segments.tr: 또한 입법에 쓰여야 할 시간과 관심을 소모할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Supporters see them as an essential check on executive power; critics often see them as political theater.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이를 행정부에 대한 필수적인 견제로 보지만, 비판자들은 종종 이를 정치적 쇼로 여깁니다.

segments.src: Which view applies often depends on which party is being investigated, a reminder that both parties have used the same tools when they were in the opposition.
segments.tr: 어떤 관점이 적용되는지는 종종 어느 정당이 조사를 받고 있는지에 따라 달라지며, 이는 양당 모두 야당이었을 때 동일한 수단을 사용해 왔음을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Confirmations and the Courts
segments.tr: ## 인준과 법원

segments.src: The Senate confirms cabinet officers, ambassadors and federal judges.
segments.tr: 상원은 각료, 대사, 연방 판사를 인준합니다.

segments.src: Since rule changes in 2013 and 2017, most nominations, including Supreme Court nominees, can advance on a simple majority rather than 60 votes.
segments.tr: 2013년과 2017년의 규칙 변경 이후, 대법관 후보자를 포함한 대부분의 인명은 60표가 아닌 단순 과반수로 통과될 수 있게 되었습니다.

segments.src: That means the party that controls the Senate has substantial power over who gets confirmed.
segments.tr: 이는 상원을 장악한 정당이 누구를 인준할지에 대해 상당한 권한을 가지고 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: If the Senate and the White House are in different hands, expect longer waits, more withdrawn nominations and greater reliance on acting officials.
segments.tr: 상원과 백악관이 다른 당에 의해 장악되어 있다면, 더 긴 대기 시간, 더 많은 인선 철회, 그리고 권한대행 공직자에 대한 더 큰 의존을 예상해야 합니다.

segments.src: If they are aligned, confirmations tend to move faster, even when the House is in opposition.
segments.tr: 두 기관이 일치할 경우, 하원이 야당일지라도 인준은 더 빨리 진행되는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: This makes the Senate result especially important for judicial and executive-branch appointments.
segments.tr: 이로 인해 상원 선거 결과는 사법부 및 행정부 임명에 특히 중요해집니다.

segments.src: ## The Debt: Where Deadlines Meet Markets
segments.tr: ## 부채: 마감 시한이 시장과 만나는 곳

segments.src: The federal debt has grown past $37 trillion, and annual deficits have been large in both good and bad economic years.
segments.tr: 연방 부채는 37조 달러를 넘어섰고, 연간 적자는 경제가 좋을 때나 나쁠 때나 모두 컸습니다.

segments.src: The statutory debt limit does not authorize new spending.
segments.tr: 법정 부채 한도는 새로운 지출을 승인하지 않습니다.

segments.src: It caps the borrowing needed to pay for obligations Congress has already approved.
segments.tr: 이는 의회가 이미 승인한 의무를 지불하는 데 필요한 차입 한도를 제한할 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Because of that, failing to raise or suspend it risks missed payments, which could disrupt financial markets.
segments.tr: 이로 인해 이를 늘리거나 유예하지 못하면 지급 불이행의 위험이 생기고, 이는 금융 시장을 혼란에 빠뜨릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Divided government has often made debt-limit votes tense, since the party out of power may use the vote to demand spending restraint.
segments.tr: 분점 정부는 권력을 잃은 정당이 지출 절제를 요구하기 위해 투표를 이용할 수 있기 때문에 부채 한도 표결을 종종 긴장감 있게 만들었습니다.

segments.src: Historically, each standoff has ended with a deal, but the deals have sometimes arrived close to the projected deadline, and the 2011 downgrade shows that even a near miss can carry a cost.
segments.tr: 역사적으로 각 대치는 합의로 끝났지만, 합의는 때때로 예상된 마감 시한에 임박해서 이루어졌으며, 2011년의 신용등급 강등은 아슬아슬하게 피한 위기조차도 대가를 치를 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

segments.src: It is also worth noting that divided government does not reliably reduce deficits.
segments.tr: 분점 정부가 적자를 확실히 줄여주지는 않는다는 점도 주목할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: Spending caps and negotiated deals have sometimes slowed spending growth, but major drivers of the debt, such as Social Security, Medicare, health costs and interest payments, are rarely changed in a split Congress, because they usually require broad political agreement.
segments.tr: 지출 상한선과 협상된 합의가 때때로 지출 증가를 둔화시켰지만, 사회보장, 메디케어, 의료비, 이자 지급 등 부채의 주요 동인은 분열된 의회에서 거의 변경되지 않는데, 이는 대개 광범위한 정치적 합의를 필요로 하기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Which chamber flips.** A new House majority controls spending bills, investigations and impeachment; a new Senate majority controls confirmations.
segments.tr: - **어느 원이 뒤집히는가.** 새로운 하원 다수당은 지출 법안, 조사, 탄핵을 통제하고, 새로운 상원 다수당은 인준을 통제합니다.

segments.src: - **The calendar.** Government funding, expiring programs and any debt-limit date create natural pressure points.
segments.tr: - **일정.** 정부 자금 지원, 만료되는 프로그램, 그리고 모든 부채 한도 날짜가 자연스러운 압박 지점을 만듭니다.

segments.src: - **The size of the majorities.** A narrow margin gives small groups of lawmakers outsized influence, whichever party leads.
segments.tr: - **다수당의 규모.** 좁은 과반수 의석은 어느 정당이 이끌든 소수의 의원들에게 막대한 영향력을 줍니다.

segments.src: - **Willingness to compromise.** Some divided Congresses have produced significant bipartisan laws, while others produced little but standoffs.
segments.tr: - **타협 의지.** 일부 분열된 의회는 유의미한 초당파적 법안을 만들어낸 반면, 다른 의회는 대치 외에는 거의 만들어내지 못했습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A divided Congress is not automatically gridlock, and it is not automatically a crisis.
segments.tr: 분열된 의회가 자동으로 기능 마비를 의미하는 것은 아니며, 자동으로 위기를 의미하는 것도 아닙니다.

segments.src: It does shift how Washington works: fewer sweeping laws, more negotiation around deadlines, more scrutiny of the executive branch, and more contested nominations.
segments.tr: 다만 워싱턴이 작동하는 방식을 바꾸어 놓습니다. 광범위한 법안은 줄어들고, 마감 시한을 둘러싼 협상이 늘어나며, 행정부에 대한 감시가 강화되고, 인준을 둘러싼 논란이 커집니다.

segments.src: Voters weighing the midterms may find it useful to ask not only which party they prefer, but also which kind of Washington they expect to get.
segments.tr: 중간선거를 저울질하는 유권자들은 자신이 선호하는 정당이 어느 당인지뿐만 아니라, 자신이 기대하는 워싱턴의 모습이 어떤 것인지 자문해 보는 것이 유용할 수 있습니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 정치적 지지나 재정적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.
